fields.location: Dam crest, left abutment to spillway; downstream toe road; Lakeshore Rd boat ramp
fields.summary: On the afternoon crest patrol I found the perimeter fence cut at the left abutment access gate, with fresh footprints toward the gate hoist house. At 13:52 a small quadcopter was hovering about 300 ft over the spillway gates and stayed there. From the crest I could see a person with a controller beside a grey pickup at the public boat ramp on Lakeshore Rd. Hoist house locked; no damage seen to the gates.

findings.notes: Chain-link cut ~1.2 m vertical next to gate post, fresh cut ends
Locked; footprints in mud to within 10 m

actionsTaken: Radioed Dam Security Supervisor at 13:58; supervisor confirmed drone track on detection console
Photographed fence cut, footprints, drone and the pickup at the boat ramp (plate not readable)
Stayed on crest and kept the hoist house in view until relieved by Patrol 1 at 14:20
recommendations: Temporary repair of fence cut and a second padlock on the abutment gate today
Request sheriff's office contact the drone operator at the boat ramp
Clean or replace CCTV C-04 lens; inspect toe drain outfalls on next round
